text:
maria: heads-up: multiple customers reporting 5xx/gateway timeouts from hosted inference in us-west-2 — spike started ~15m ago. error rate ~12% for a couple routes. request_id examples: req_8a3f, req_b27c. Support says timeouts are 30s HTTP timeouts.

lee: customer-reports link: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/2456 — they included logs with repeated "upstream prematurely closed connection" and lots of queued requests. no auth/billing signs.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-314 (page sent to oncall).

maria: tagging @ryan and @anya — can you triage? feels like scale-up lag + coldstart.

ryan: looking at ingress and autoscaler metrics now. initial observation: HPA shows minReplicas=0 for the model pool and current replica count 0 -> scaling to 1 takes ~40-60s, model warmup adds another 20-30s. KEDA ScaledObject shows triggers on queueLength but scaler pollInterval is 30s and cooldown is 120s. that combo explains slow reaction.

anya: runtime note: model container performs full model mmap+quant init on startup; warmup path exists but only runs if replicas >0 at deploy time. when HPA spins from 0 we see extra 15-25s. we have batching and cache warmups which require a single successful inference to prime KV caches.

samir: rolling logs (snip):
```
2026-03-15T10:03:12Z ingress-gateway error "502 upstream prematurely closed connection" request_id=req_8a3f
2026-03-15T10:03:18Z pod/model-pool-0 WARN "no ready backends, queueing request" qlen=23
2026-03-15T10:04:05Z pod/model-pool-0 INFO "backend ready, warming model"
2026-03-15T10:04:25Z pod/model-pool-0 INFO "first inference completed, KV cache size=1"
```

lee: customers see HTTP 504s and UX timeouts. support escalated high priority due to SLA. are there billing implications? customers were charged for successful requests only; most timeouts were before completion. I'll keep billing team looped.

ryan: quick kubectl outputs:
```
$ kubectl get hpa -n hosted inference-pool-hpa
NAME                    REFERENCE                  TARGETS        MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
inference-pool-hpa      Deployment/inference-pool  80%/100%       0         50        0          3d
$ kubectl get scaledobject -n hosted inference-pool-scaledobject -o yaml
# scaledObject: triggers: queueLength  targetAverageValue: 50  pollingInterval: 30  cooldownPeriod: 120
```

anya: that pollingInterval is too long for bursty traffic. KEDA won't notice the spike for up to 30s, then cooldown delays further scaling. also HPA min 0 is fine for cost but bad for latency-sensitive endpoints.

maria: immediate mitigation options?

ryan: emergency patch suggestion (fast): set HPA minReplicas=2 for the pool, reduce KEDA pollingInterval to 5s and cooldownPeriod to 30s. also add a readinessProbe initialDelaySeconds=10 so kube stops sending traffic until basic hotpath is alive. finally, create a short-lived prewarm job that ensures at least one container has run warmup at deploy.

anya: agree. I'll prepare a small patch for the runtime image to run warmup earlier (execute load of model weights in entrypoint) but that's medium-term. short-term config changes above should be safe.

lee: I've opened a customer-facing note to say we're investigating and expect partial mitigation in ~10-15m.

maria: can someone run the kubectl patch now? I can approve emergency change. @samir you have the deploy keys?

samir: I can run it. patching HPA and scaledobject now.

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT STARTED: patch/hpa-min-2 by samir.

samir: commands used:
```
kubectl patch hpa inference-pool-hpa -n hosted --type merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: inference-pool-scaledobject
  namespace: hosted
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    deploymentName: inference-pool
  pollingInterval: 5
  cooldownPeriod: 30
  triggers:
  - type: queueLength
    metadata:
      queueLength: "50"
EOF
```

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT SUCCESS: patch/hpa-min-2 (3 of 3 changed).

ryan: observing metrics: replica count jumped to 3 within ~20s after KEDA change. warmup still adds ~25s for new pods, but with minReplicas=2 we have warm pods available for most requests. queue length dropped from 120 -> single digits. 5xx rate down to <1% in the last 5m.

lee: customers updated: thank you for quick fix, response rates returning to normal. will confirm with affected accounts before closing.

maria: follow-ups:
- eng-runtime (anya) to add warmup-on-start flag in next patch and document deploy checklist.
- eng-sre (ryan) to propose safer default KEDA pollingInterval/cooldown per pool tier.
- support (lee) to run postmortem repro steps + replay traffic to test autoscaler.
- infra (samir) to add a prewarm cron job option for high-SLA customers.

anya: noted, I'll file a PR for warmup and add a feature flag for customers to opt-in to preloaded images.

ryan: I'll draft an RFC for autoscaler defaults this week. initial takeaway: for latency-SLO endpoints minReplicas should not be 0; use a cost/SLO knob in Console.

maria: closing incident for now since 5xx back to baseline and customers acknowledged. keeping this thread open for follow-ups. great cross-team response :thumbsup:.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: INC-2026-314 (acknowledged).
